plan.scope: Measure conditional table stages, then reuse an exactly matched pre-action articulation prefix when the prior post-action suffix differs. Preserve all numerical outputs, unknown support, class/issue/group identity and timing policy.

load_weighted_control.correction: The two preceding timing/arrival runs used stair configs with all-zero gesture weights even when their weighted label was true. Preserve their measurements, but those labels did not provide a nonzero gesture-weight control. This run pins genuinely nonzero weights before acquisition.

contract.cache: Within one table build retain the latest complete-hop prefix and one complete-hop pre-action checkpoint. No partial-hop checkpoint, new heap allocation or state carried across table builds.
contract.match: Each retained prefix is retagged only after the caller proves equality of all profile masks and eleven f64 bit patterns through that prefix. Successfully proven equal key/frame/end checkpoints share one comparison. No approximate feature matching.
contract.ownership: Projection rechecks group handle, issue sample, trajectory and endpoint; it uses the latest matching prefix ending no later than evaluation. Rewind, differing prefix and changed group/issue remain guarded.
contract.preservation: The same ordered transitions, merging, pruning, unknown mass and reporting are resumed from the saved state. Body profile, action/evaluation times, unsupported data, original observations and I11 action policy are unchanged.
contract.profiling: Optional test-only thread-local stage timings are enabled solely by CONCHORDAL_I10_PROFILE_PROJECTION=1 in the ignored load assay. They cover feature windows, grouping, articulation, residual/closure, accent/arrival, continuation, prefix matching and raw mixture. They do not enter ordinary binaries and are disabled during paired load timings.

verification.scope: Exact numerical reuse of conditional articulation paths within one table build. No approximation, timing adoption or whole-I10 resource acceptance. Stage timings are test-only and distinct from unprofiled paired runs.

corrections.finding: The two preceding timing/arrival runs used stair configs with all-zero gesture weights even when their weighted label was true. Preserve their measurements, but those labels did not provide a nonzero gesture-weight control. This run pins genuinely nonzero weights before acquisition.
corrections.retained: Prior numerical/support measurements and frozen artifacts are preserved. Their weighted=true labels do not establish a nonzero gesture-coefficient contrast. Current load configs pin nonzero coefficients and the verifier requires an actual articulation-output difference for all eight contrasts.

limits: Exact replay equivalence is not calibration, actual-body transfer fidelity or audible benefit.
